description:
Bills Manager is a local-first personal bill tracker for iPhone and iPad. Organize rent, utilities, credit cards, and digital subscriptions in one place, get local due-date reminders, and never miss a payment.

WHY BILLS MANAGER
• Local-first privacy — data stays on your device with SwiftData (no account required)
• Recurring bills — daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, and more
• Smart statuses — Overdue, Due Today, Due Soon, Upcoming, Paid
• Interactive calendar — month grid with color dots for each bill state
• Dashboard — overdue banner, this-month due/paid totals, upcoming list
• Analytics — Swift Charts category breakdown by period
• Payment history — amount, reference, and receipt photos
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID lock (PRO)
• CSV export and full JSON backup (PRO)

FREE
• Unlimited bills and due-date tracking
• Calendar, dashboard, and basic analytics
• Local notifications and app badge
• Up to 5 custom categories and payment accounts

PRO (In-App Purchase)
• Unlimited custom categories and payment accounts
• CSV export and JSON full backup
• Face ID / Touch ID / passcode lock
• Full advanced charts and analytics
• Ad-free experience

Plans: Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime unlock via Apple In-App Purchase. Prices are shown on the App Store. Manage or cancel auto-renewal anytime in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

PRIVACY
Core features work offline. No third-party ads or tracking SDKs. See the privacy policy for details.
promotionalText: Never miss a bill. Local reminders, calendar, and PRO tools for export and lock.
